title: Marvelous Designer 2024.0: Auto Convertir A Avatar

summary: ```# Marvelous Designer 2024.0: Auto Convertir a Avatar Welcome to a new Marvelous Designer 2024 tutorial. In this video, we will cover the new function **Autoconvert to Avatar**. ## Overview of Autoconvert to Avatar You can automatically convert avatars created in other software into predetermined avatars in Marvelous Designer. ### Steps to Access Autoconvert 1. Click on the main menu. 2. Navigate to **Avatar**. 3. Select **Autoconvert to Avatar**. When you click on **Autoconvert to Avatar**, an emergency window will appear. ## Loading the Avatar ### Supported File Formats Load the avatar. Keep in mind that you can import avatars in the following file formats: - **.avt** - **.ovj** - **.fbx** We recommend that the avatar is in **Pose A** for optimal results. ## Selecting Avatar Characteristics ### Gender Selection Select the type of gender you want for your new predetermined avatar. You can convert to the following options: - Woman - Man - Boy - Girl - Infant - Baby ### Conversion Options The conversion option allows you to choose between **automatic** or **custom**. We recommend choosing **custom** for avatars imported from other software, as this option keeps the rig. ### Hand and Feet Modification If the option to exclude hands and feet is marked, the original avatar's hands and feet will be modified. The conversion will be based on the predetermined avatar's hands and feet in Marvelous Designer. ## Skin Style and Rigging Options ### MD Skin Style We select **MD Skin Style**. This keeps the original avatar's body type and converts only its appearance to the avatar of Marvelous Designer, while also adding joints. ### Rigging Options When you select only **rigging**, add joints keeping the body shape and appearance of the original avatar. - **Editable Size**: Change the avatar's body shape and add joints to Marvelous Designer, allowing the size to be edited while keeping the original avatar's touch. ## Saving the Avatar ### File Name and Location You can specify a name to save the avatar. With the **file route**, you can specify the location where you want to save the avatar. ### Conversion Process 1. Click on the **convert button** to convert to the original avatar format. 2. When you select **open folder**, you will see the avatar file in the location you specified. 3. Click on the **convert button**. The avatar file will appear in the window. 4. Click on the **save button**. You'll see that your avatar has been converted to the three conversion types that appear on the 3D window. ## Importing and Converting FBX Files This time, we'll import an **FBX** file with no rigging and convert it by marking **MD Skin Style** and **Solo Rigging**. ### Automatic Rigging Keep in mind that for avatars without a rig, Marvelous Designer will automatically set the rigging shape of the predetermined avatar for you. By sharing the same shape of the body, you can also use the same positioning points. ## Conclusion This allows your personalized avatar to have access to Marvelous Designer functions, such as basic movement animations, deformable mesh simulation, and more tools in Marvelous Designer. Ladies and gentlemen, we will now present Marvelous Designer for your next custom return project. For more information, visit [Marvel Marketing](http://www.marvelmarketing.com). ```
